title: Yellow rice, cooked, no added fat

content.title: About
content.content: Yellow rice is cooked rice that has been colored with turmeric, saffron or other spices to give it a distinctive golden hue. This product contains no added fats, keeping it low‑calorie and suitable for diet‑focused meals.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Yellow rice is a staple in many Latin American and Asian dishes.
The bright color is traditionally achieved with turmeric, saffron or food coloring.
Rice provides the primary source of carbohydrates for over half of the world’s population.
The lack of added fat makes it ideal for calorie‑conscious eating.
Turmeric, used for coloring, contains curcumin – a powerful antioxidant.

items.title: Source of complex carbs
items.content: Rice delivers a steady supply of energy through slowly digestible carbohydrates.

items.title: Low in fat
items.content: No added fat helps maintain a low‑calorie profile.

items.title: Rich in B‑vitamins
items.content: Contains thiamine, niacin and vitamin B6, which support energy metabolism.

items.title: Contains antioxidants
items.content: Turmeric adds curcumin, known for its anti‑inflammatory properties.

items.title: Supports digestion
items.content: The fiber in rice aids regular bowel function.

items.title: Rice allergy
items.content: Some individuals may experience allergic reactions to rice.

items.title: High glycemic index
items.content: Rice can raise blood sugar quickly, so people with diabetes should monitor portions.

items.title: Arsenic content
items.content: Rice may contain trace amounts of arsenic; a varied diet helps mitigate risk.

items.title: Hidden additives
items.content: Check the label for any added oils or salt when purchasing pre‑cooked rice.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Yellow rice can be served as a side dish with meat, fish or vegetables, incorporated into salads, soups and casseroles. It reheats well in the microwave or on the stovetop, adding a splash of water to restore moisture.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store cooked yellow rice in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3‑4 days. For longer storage, freeze portions in bags for up to 2 months. Reheat to at least 75 °C before consumption.
